tasks.title: logout_gate: work without fcntl (Windows)
tasks.notes: lib/blocks/logout_gate.py session_lock_held uses fcntl.lockf (POSIX only), so the logout gate and scripts/check_instance.py fail on Windows. Replace with a portable check (msvcrt.locking on Windows, or try opening the lock file exclusively). Keep the rule that session.lock existence proves nothing. Add a test with a fake lock.

tasks.title: Portability pass for Linux and Windows users
tasks.notes: Audit tool-repo assumptions before sharing the code: python3 vs py -3 in AGENTS.md and skills; jq/grep/zsh in hooks; pyproj OSTN15 lookup only checks Homebrew paths (lib/geo/world_frame.py); GDAL/ogr2ogr requirement for osm_extract; agent-soundboard cue must be optional; any absolute /Users paths left in tool docs. Document Windows as WSL-first unless fixed. Setup doc: docs/minecraft-instance-setup.md.
